Stem of the Question

3.c) | Consider the following relations:
Hotel (hotelNo, name, address)
Room (roomNo, hotelNo, type, price)
Booking (hotelNo, guestNo, dateFrom, dateTo, roomNo)
Guest (guestNo, name, address)
Write the SQL statements for the following:
i) List all family rooms with a price below Rs.400, in ascending order
of price.
ii) Display the number of hotels.
iii) Display guestNo, name, address and roomNo details of guests
booked room from 01-Jan-23.
iv) Display hotelNo and the number of rooms in each hotel.

What is Normalization? Differentiate between BCNF and 3 NF with
proper example.
4.b) | What do you mean by redundancy? Discuss about insertion, updation

and deletion anomalies.
